_comment: Kiro MCP config template — Outlook + Slack + Obsidian (+ optional enterprise tooling). Copy to mcp.json (gitignored) and replace every [BRACKETED] placeholder. See docs/enterprise-mcp-patterns.md for the full walkthrough. JSON has no comments, so guidance lives in the _comment fields and the docs.

obsidian._comment: Local Obsidian vault over the filesystem MCP. On Windows, npx.cmd needs an explicit PATH so it resolves; on Mac/Linux use "npx" and drop the env block.

aws-outlook-mcp._comment: Corporate Outlook email + calendar. OUTLOOK_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true allows sending/booking (still gated by propose-before-send in the steering). First use triggers a browser OAuth flow. Replace the command/args with however your Outlook MCP binary launches. This example shells into a Linux distro via WSL; a Mac/Linux host would invoke the binary directly.

slack-mcp._comment: Team Slack. ENFORCE_DRAFTS=true means any reply is saved to your Slack compose box for manual review — never auto-posted. Replace [SLACK_MCP_BINARY_PATH] with your Slack MCP binary. The chmod 600 prefix is an enterprise-specific auth-cookie permission fix — drop it if your Slack MCP authenticates differently.

enterprise-tooling-mcp._comment: OPTIONAL: your company's internal-tooling MCP (wikis, ticketing, code search, docs). Delete this whole block if you don't have one. Example shown for an Amazon 'builder-mcp'; substitute your own. Only read-only tools are auto-approved.
